Run the Crop Rotation Visualization Application

Source: R/run_app.R
run_visualization_app.Rd

Launches the Shiny application for visualizing crop rotation plans and their impact. The application provides an interactive interface for exploring rotation patterns, analyzing sustainability metrics, and understanding environmental effects of different cropping sequences.

run_visualization_app(input_dir = NA, crop_colors = NULL)

Arguments

input_dir

Optional filepath to custom input data directory. If NA (default), you have to choose it manually in the app.

crop_colors

Optional named character vector mapping crop names to colors (hex codes or R color names). Crops not present in this vector receive colors from the built-in palette; any remaining unmapped crops are assigned random colors. Use NULL (default) to rely entirely on the built-in palette.

Value

A Shiny application object

Details

The function initializes the visualization environment by:

  1. Loading built-in or custom input data

  2. Setting up the resource paths for static assets

  3. Launching the Shiny server with configured UI and server logic

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
run_visualization_app()
run_visualization_app("path/to/custom/data")

# Custom crop color palette
my_colors <- c(
